The syndicate reports a prior-year net release of GBP 22.8m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end; however the report does not disclose the equivalent gross prior-year development figure. The release is attributed principally to favourable run-off in long-tail casualty classes and adjustments to IBNR. The portfolio remains exposed to prior international catastrophe events (notably New Zealand and Japan earthquakes and Thai floods) and to 2012's Super-storm Sandy, which are cited as drivers of uncertainty on gross ultimate outcomes.
